citation.authors: Harmon KG, Drezner JA, Klossner D, Asif IM

cited_by.title: Sickle cell trait and hard exercise

record.design: Review of sudden deaths and screening cost-effectiveness
record.finding: Five deaths (2%) were associated with sickle cell trait, all in Black Division I football players. The risk of exertional death in Division I football players with the trait was 1 in 827, which was 37 times higher than in players without it.
record.note: Counter-signal to the Army cohort. Small numbers of deaths; a narrow, extreme setting (elite American football training).
